name: watch jobs 5+6
command:
while true; do curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8321/api/jobs | python3 -c "
import json,sys
js = {j['id']: j for j in json.load(sys.stdin)}
s5, s6 = js.get(5,{}).get('state','?'), js.get(6,{}).get('state','?')
print('job5:', s5, '| job6:', s6)
term = ('done','error','cancelled')
exit(0 if s5 in term and s6 in term else 1)" && exit 0; sleep 120; done
description: watch shapes jobs 5 and 6 until terminal
